List distinct compound ChEMBL IDs, compound names, and canonical SMILES for molecules reported in document CHEMBL5727344. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
